title: 蘇通長江公路大橋~Sutong Yangtze River Bridge
focus: 長江口軟弱深厚地層上的 1,088 m 斜張橋：摩擦樁群、300 m 塔、阻尼限位體系與長索控制~A 1,088 m cable-stayed span on deep soft estuary ground: friction pile groups, 300 m towers, damper–limiter system and long-stay control
summary: 蘇通長江公路大橋以 1,088 m 主跨跨越寬約 6 km 的長江口，主橋孔跨為 (100+100+300)+1,088+(300+100+100) m，倒 Y 形混凝土塔高 300.4 m，鋼箱梁含風嘴寬約 41 m，最長斜索約 577 m。本課從縱向阻尼限位體系、高空風剖面、每塔 131 根鑽孔摩擦樁、鋼錨箱錨固區出發，經施工平台與節段同步提升，到氣彈模型、沖刷監測、塔柱徐變與長索多模態振動。~Sutong Yangtze River Bridge spans the roughly 6 km wide Yangtze estuary with a 1,088 m main span in a (100+100+300)+1,088+(300+100+100) m arrangement, 300.4 m inverted-Y concrete towers, a steel box deck about 41 m wide including fairings and stays up to about 577 m long. The course runs from the longitudinal damper–limiter system, wind profiles at height, the 131 bored friction piles per tower and steel anchor boxes, through work platforms and synchronised segment lifting, to aeroelastic testing, scour monitoring, tower creep and multi-mode vibration of long stays.

units.anchor: 塔梁間黏滯阻尼器~Tower–deck viscous dampers
units.title: 縱向約束：黏滯阻尼器加位移限位~Longitudinal restraint: viscous dampers with displacement limiters
units.mechanism: 蘇通大橋主橋全長 2,088 m，若橋面在塔處完全固定，溫度伸縮與混凝土塔的徐變會在塔底產生巨大彎矩；若完全漂浮，颱風、船撞與地震又會讓橋面大幅縱飄，撞壞伸縮縫。設計團隊比較多種體系後，採用附加位移限制裝置的超大型液體黏滯阻尼器，公開論文指出這是此類裝置在橋梁工程的首次應用。慢速的溫度位移幾乎不受阻；快速的風振與地震由阻尼器耗能；位移一旦達到限位值，限位裝置接手，防止極端事件中橋面超出伸縮縫與支承的行程。~The Sutong main bridge is 2,088 m long. Fixing the deck to the towers would let thermal movement and tower creep create huge tower-base moments; a fully floating deck would let typhoons, ship impact and earthquakes push it far enough to wreck the expansion joints. After comparing systems, the design team adopted very large fluid viscous dampers with an added displacement limiter, described in a published paper as the first use of such a device in bridge engineering. Slow thermal movement is almost unresisted, fast wind and seismic motion is dissipated by the dampers, and once displacement reaches the limit the limiter takes over so the deck cannot exceed joint and bearing travel in an extreme event.
units.model: 溫度位移 ΔL = α·L·ΔT，取 α = 1.2×10⁻⁵/°C、自中點起算 L = 1,044 m、ΔT = 50 °C：ΔL ≈ 0.63 m。阻尼力 F = C·v^α：若 v = 0.4 m/s 時 F = 2,000 kN、α = 0.4，C = 2,000/0.4^0.4 ≈ 2,885 kN/(m/s)^0.4；v = 0.05 m/s 時 F ≈ 2,885×0.302 ≈ 870 kN。數值為教學假設。~Thermal movement ΔL = α·L·ΔT; with α = 1.2×10⁻⁵/°C, L = 1,044 m from mid-length and ΔT = 50 °C, ΔL ≈ 0.63 m. Damper force F = C·v^α: if F = 2,000 kN at v = 0.4 m/s with α = 0.4, C = 2,000/0.4^0.4 ≈ 2,885 kN/(m/s)^0.4, and at v = 0.05 m/s F ≈ 2,885×0.302 ≈ 870 kN. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 阻尼器以實尺寸試驗機做力—速度與疲勞循環試驗，限位裝置驗證觸發位移與剛度；安裝後監測塔梁相對位移、阻尼器行程與溫度，確認日常位移落在非限位區，事件後檢查行程紀錄是否觸及限位。~Test full-size dampers for force–velocity behaviour and fatigue cycling and verify the limiter’s engagement displacement and stiffness; after installation monitor tower–deck displacement, damper stroke and temperature to confirm daily movement stays outside the limiter zone, and after events check whether the stroke record reached the limit.
units.failure: 若限位值設得太小，日常溫度位移就會頂到限位，塔底承受不必要的彎矩；阻尼器漏油或密封磨耗會讓阻尼下降，強風時橋面縱向擺幅增加，伸縮縫與支承加速損壞。~A limit set too small lets daily thermal movement hit it, imposing unnecessary tower-base moments; oil leakage or seal wear reduces damping so the deck swings further longitudinally in strong wind, accelerating joint and bearing damage.
units.misconception: 黏滯阻尼器在任何速度下都提供相同的固定約束力。~A viscous damper provides the same fixed restraint force at every velocity.
units.practice: 阻尼器與限位裝置的參數要與伸縮縫、支承的設計行程一起列表核對，並在維護手冊規定行程刻度巡檢、漏油判定與更換時的臨時約束方案。~Tabulate damper and limiter parameters against the design travel of joints and bearings, and specify stroke-scale inspections, leak criteria and a temporary restraint scheme for replacement in the maintenance manual.

units.title: 長江口風剖面與 300 m 塔的風荷載~Estuary wind profile and wind load on 300 m towers
units.mechanism: 蘇通大橋位於開闊的長江口，地表粗糙度低，風速隨高度增加明顯。主塔高 300.4 m，塔頂的風速遠高於橋面高度，而風壓又與風速平方成正比，所以塔上段承受的單位面積風力可比橋面高出四成以上。公開論文指出，300 m 高塔對風極為敏感，施工期的抗風問題尤其重要：塔柱在自立狀態下頻率低、沒有斜索與橋面約束，容易出現渦致振動與大幅擺動，需以臨時連接或阻尼措施控制。~Sutong Bridge sits in the open Yangtze estuary, where low surface roughness makes wind speed rise markedly with height. The towers are 300.4 m tall, so wind speed at the top is far above that at deck level, and because pressure goes with the square of speed, the upper tower can see over four-tenths more pressure per unit area than the deck. Published papers stress that a 300 m tower is highly wind-sensitive, especially during construction: a free-standing tower has low frequencies and no restraint from stays or deck, so it is prone to vortex-induced vibration and large sway that must be controlled with temporary ties or damping.
units.model: 指數律風剖面 U(z) = U₁₀·(z/10)^α。取 U₁₀ = 38 m/s、α = 0.12：橋面 z = 70 m 時 U ≈ 38×1.263 ≈ 48.0 m/s；塔頂 z = 300 m 時 U ≈ 38×1.504 ≈ 57.2 m/s；風壓比 (57.2/48.0)² ≈ 1.42。風速與指數為教學假設。~Power-law profile U(z) = U₁₀·(z/10)^α. With U₁₀ = 38 m/s and α = 0.12, the deck at z = 70 m sees U ≈ 38×1.263 ≈ 48.0 m/s and the tower top at z = 300 m sees U ≈ 38×1.504 ≈ 57.2 m/s; the pressure ratio is (57.2/48.0)² ≈ 1.42. Speeds and exponent are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以橋址氣象站與塔上不同高度的風速計長期量測，擬合實際風剖面指數與紊流強度，與設計假設比較；自立塔階段在塔頂設加速度計，觀察渦振的風速與振幅，確認臨時抑振措施有效。~Measure long-term wind at the site station and on anemometers at several tower heights, fit the actual profile exponent and turbulence intensity and compare with design assumptions; during the free-standing tower stage place accelerometers at the top to observe vortex vibration speeds and amplitudes and confirm temporary suppression works.
units.failure: 若沿用橋面高度的風速設計塔上段與施工設備，塔吊、爬模與錨箱吊裝可能在高處遭遇超出預期的風力；自立塔渦振若未控制，反覆擺動會使施工機具與未硬化混凝土受損。~Designing the upper tower and its equipment for deck-level wind can expose tower cranes, climbing forms and anchor-box lifts to unexpectedly high forces at height; uncontrolled vortex vibration of the free-standing tower can damage equipment and green concrete through repeated sway.
units.misconception: 同一座橋的風速在任何高度都一樣，只需要用一個設計風速。~Wind speed is the same at every height on a bridge, so one design speed is enough.
units.practice: 施工計畫應依高度分段訂出塔吊與爬模的停工風速，並把自立塔最高狀態的抗風措施列為停留檢查點；塔上風速計資料要與施工日誌同步保存。~The method statement should set stop-work wind speeds for cranes and climbing forms by height band, with wind measures for the tallest free-standing state a hold point; tower anemometer data should be archived alongside the site diary.

units.title: 131 根鑽孔摩擦樁的承載與群樁效應~Capacity of 131 bored friction piles and group effects
units.mechanism: 長江口的沉積層極厚，岩盤深達約 300 m，基樁無法嵌岩，只能靠樁側摩擦與樁端承載把荷重傳到砂土層。公開報導指出每座主塔由 131 根直徑達 2.8 m、長約 120 m 的鑽孔灌注樁支承，群樁平面約 114 m × 48 m。摩擦樁的承載主要來自深部砂層的側阻，群樁中各樁應力球重疊，群樁沉陷大於單樁；同時水流沖刷會把上部土層移走，降低有效埋深與側阻。因此設計同時檢查單樁承載、群樁沉陷與沖刷後的承載折減。~The Yangtze estuary sediments are extremely thick, with rock about 300 m down, so piles cannot be socketed into rock and must carry load by shaft friction and end bearing in sand layers. Public reports state that each main tower stands on 131 bored cast-in-place piles up to 2.8 m in diameter and about 120 m long, in a group about 114 m × 48 m in plan. Friction-pile capacity comes mainly from shaft resistance in deep sands; stress bulbs overlap within the group, so group settlement exceeds single-pile settlement, and scour removes upper soil, reducing embedment and shaft resistance. Design therefore checks single-pile capacity, group settlement and capacity after scour together.
units.model: 單樁側阻 Q_s = π·D·L·f_s。取 D = 2.8 m、有效長 L = 117 m、平均側阻 f_s = 60 kPa：Q_s = π×2.8×117×60 ≈ 61,750 kN；端阻以 3,000 kPa 計 Q_b = π×2.8²/4×3,000 ≈ 18,470 kN。若沖刷使有效長減 10 m，Q_s 降約 5,280 kN。土壤參數為教學假設。~Single-pile shaft capacity Q_s = π·D·L·f_s. With D = 2.8 m, effective length L = 117 m and mean shaft friction f_s = 60 kPa, Q_s = π×2.8×117×60 ≈ 61,750 kN; end bearing at 3,000 kPa gives Q_b = π×2.8²/4×3,000 ≈ 18,470 kN. If scour removes 10 m of effective length, Q_s falls by about 5,280 kN. Soil parameters are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以試樁的靜載試驗或自平衡（雙向）試驗取得荷重—沉陷曲線，反算各土層側阻並修正設計參數；工程樁以聲波透測檢查完整性，樁底沉渣以測繩或鑽芯確認；施工與營運期以水準與沉陷板監測群樁沉陷。~Use static or self-balanced bidirectional load tests on trial piles to obtain load–settlement curves, back-calculate layer shaft friction and correct the design parameters; check working piles by cross-hole sonic logging, verify base cleanliness by sounding or coring, and monitor group settlement with levelling and settlement plates during construction and service.
units.failure: 樁底沉渣過厚或泥漿護壁形成厚泥皮，會大幅降低端阻與側阻，使單樁沉陷超出預期；群樁不均勻沉陷會使承台傾斜，進而改變塔軸與斜索索力分布。~Thick base sediment or a heavy bentonite filter cake sharply reduces end and shaft resistance so single piles settle more than predicted; uneven group settlement tilts the cap, changing the tower axis and the distribution of stay forces.
units.misconception: 基樁一定要打到岩盤才可靠，摩擦樁不適合大橋主塔。~Piles must reach rock to be reliable; friction piles are unsuitable for major bridge towers.
units.practice: 大型摩擦樁群要先做試樁再定案樁長，並把鑽孔垂直度、泥漿性質、沉渣厚度與灌注連續性列為每根樁的檢查項目；試樁報告要回饋到設計並由設計單位確認。~For large friction-pile groups, test trial piles before finalising pile length, make drilling verticality, slurry properties, base sediment and continuity of concreting checklist items for every pile, and feed trial-pile reports back to the designer for confirmation.

units.title: 鋼錨箱與混凝土塔壁的組合錨固區~Composite anchorage zone of steel boxes and concrete walls
units.mechanism: 公開論文指出，蘇通大橋塔的斜索錨固區採鋼—混凝土組合結構，構造與受力都相當複雜，長期耐久性需特別關注。斜索的水平分力會把塔壁向外拉開，若只靠混凝土承受就需要大量環向預力；把鋼錨箱嵌入塔內後，兩側斜索的水平分力大部分在鋼錨箱內自我平衡，剩餘部分再經剪力連接件傳給混凝土。力量如何在鋼與混凝土之間分配，取決於兩者的相對勁度與連接件的滑移，因此錨固區的設計需要精細的局部分析與試驗。~Published papers state that the Sutong tower anchorage zone uses a steel–concrete composite structure whose construction and load behaviour are complex, with long-term durability needing close attention. The horizontal components of the stays try to split the tower walls apart, and resisting them with concrete alone needs heavy circumferential prestress; with steel anchor boxes embedded in the tower, most of the horizontal force from opposite stays is balanced inside the box, and the remainder passes to the concrete through shear connectors. How force is shared between steel and concrete depends on their relative stiffness and connector slip, so the anchorage zone needs detailed local analysis and testing.
units.model: 索力 T = 7,000 kN、與水平夾角 25° 時水平分力 H = 7,000×cos25° ≈ 6,344 kN。若鋼錨箱與混凝土壁的勁度比使鋼箱分擔 60%，鋼箱承受約 3,806 kN，混凝土壁約 2,538 kN；分擔比改為 80% 時混凝土只剩約 1,269 kN。數值為教學假設。~For a stay force T = 7,000 kN at 25° to the horizontal, the horizontal component is H = 7,000×cos25° ≈ 6,344 kN. If relative stiffness gives the steel box 60%, it carries about 3,806 kN and the concrete wall about 2,538 kN; at an 80% share the concrete carries only about 1,269 kN. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以足尺或大比例錨固區試體加載，量測鋼錨箱應變、剪力連接件滑移與混凝土裂縫，與局部有限元素模型比較分擔比；施工時檢查錨箱定位、焊道超音波檢測與混凝土澆置密實度。~Load full-size or large-scale anchorage specimens, measuring anchor-box strains, connector slip and concrete cracking, and compare the force share with a local finite-element model; during construction check box positioning, ultrasonic testing of welds and concrete compaction around the boxes.
units.failure: 若混凝土分擔比被低估，塔壁在使用荷載下出現豎向裂縫，水分進入後腐蝕預力與鋼筋；錨箱焊道細節不良則在斜索活載的反覆作用下產生疲勞裂縫。~Underestimating the concrete share lets vertical cracks open in the walls under service load, admitting water that corrodes prestress and reinforcement; poor weld details in the anchor box develop fatigue cracks under repeated live-load stay forces.
units.misconception: 鋼錨箱放進塔內後，混凝土塔壁就完全不受斜索水平力。~Once steel anchor boxes are in the tower, the concrete walls carry none of the horizontal stay force.
units.practice: 錨箱節段應在工廠預拼並量測斜索出口角度，現場以測量控制每節錨箱的空間位置；錨固區混凝土要有裂縫寬度檢查與記錄，作為營運期比較的基準。~Pre-assemble anchor-box segments in the shop and measure stay exit angles, control each box’s spatial position by survey on site, and record crack widths in the anchorage concrete as a baseline for in-service comparison.

units.anchor: 鋼護筒施工平台~Steel-casing work platform
units.title: 深水施工平台、鋼護筒與樁垂直度~Deep-water platforms, steel casings and pile verticality
units.mechanism: 在浪高約 3 m、潮差約 4 m、每天約 3,000 艘船通過的江面上鑽 131 根百米長樁，第一步是建立穩定的施工平台。公開報導指出，承包商原計畫以約 130 根 60 m 長臨時鋼管支撐約 117 m × 55 m 的平台，但試打的 12 根不穩定，後改用 120 m 長的永久鋼護筒兼作平台支撐。鋼護筒提供鑽孔導向並保護孔壁，其垂直度直接決定樁身在深處是否偏離設計位置；樁偏斜會改變群樁受力分配並與相鄰樁碰撞。報導指出設計垂直度容許 1/200，實際達到約 1/400。~Drilling 131 piles each about 100 m long in a river with waves of about 3 m, tides of about 4 m and some 3,000 ships a day starts with a stable work platform. Public reports state that the contractor planned about 130 temporary 60 m steel pipes to support a platform of about 117 m × 55 m, but 12 trial pipes proved unstable, so 120 m permanent steel casings were used to support the platform. The casings guide drilling and protect the bore, and their verticality determines whether the pile drifts from position at depth; inclined piles change load sharing in the group and can clash with neighbours. The reports cite a design verticality tolerance of 1/200 and achieved values of about 1/400.
units.model: 樁底偏位 e = L×傾斜率。L = 117 m 時，1/200 對應 e = 117/200 ≈ 0.59 m，1/400 對應約 0.29 m；以樁徑 2.8 m 計，前者相當於約 21% 樁徑，後者約 10%。長度為教學假設，傾斜率為公開資料。~Pile-toe offset e = L × inclination. For L = 117 m, 1/200 gives e = 117/200 ≈ 0.59 m and 1/400 about 0.29 m; with a 2.8 m pile these are about 21% and 10% of the diameter. The length is a teaching assumption; the inclinations are published values.
units.verify: 每根鋼護筒沉放時以雙向經緯儀或傾斜儀量測垂直度，鑽孔過程以超音波孔壁量測儀檢查孔徑與傾斜；完成後把每根樁的實際偏位輸入群樁模型，複核承台內力與各樁軸力。~Measure the verticality of each casing during placement with two theodolites or an inclinometer, check bore diameter and inclination with an ultrasonic caliper during drilling, and afterwards enter each pile’s actual offset into the group model to recheck cap forces and pile loads.
units.failure: 臨時平台支撐失穩可能導致鑽機傾覆與人員傷亡；樁身偏斜超限時若未重新分析，承台受力與沉陷分布會偏離設計，甚至需要補樁。~Instability of temporary platform supports can topple drilling rigs and injure crews; piles beyond tolerance that are not reanalysed shift cap forces and settlement away from the design and may require additional piles.
units.misconception: 施工平台只是臨時設施，不需要像永久結構一樣做設計檢核。~A work platform is temporary, so it needs no design checks like a permanent structure.
units.practice: 深水平台要有獨立的臨時工程設計、浪流與船撞檢核、颱風前的撤離與加固程序；樁位與垂直度量測結果應逐根簽認，超限樁由設計單位決定處理方式。~A deep-water platform needs its own temporary-works design, wave, current and ship-impact checks and pre-typhoon evacuation and securing procedures; pile position and verticality results are signed off pile by pile, with the designer deciding treatment of out-of-tolerance piles.

units.anchor: 同步提升千斤頂~Synchronised lifting jacks
units.title: 鋼箱梁大節段同步提升與合龍~Synchronised lifting of steel box segments and closure
units.mechanism: 蘇通大橋鋼箱梁以船運到位後，由懸臂端吊機或提升設備垂直吊起再與既有梁段焊接，鋼梁架設須趕在颱風季前完成。大型節段常以四個或更多吊點同步提升，節段本身與吊架都很剛硬，任何一個吊點多升或少升幾毫米，荷重就會在吊點間大幅重分配。公開報導中重型提升分包商指出，吊點間 10 mm 的相對位移就可能轉移約 35% 的荷重。因此提升系統需要電腦同步控制、每點荷重即時顯示與自動停機。全橋合龍則在 2007 年 6 月完成。~At Sutong the steel box segments were barged into position, lifted vertically by cantilever-tip cranes or lifting gear and welded to the previous segment, and girder erection had to finish before the typhoon season. Large segments are usually lifted at four or more points in synchrony; the segment and lifting frame are stiff, so if one point rises a few millimetres more or less, load redistributes sharply among the points. In public reports the heavy-lift subcontractor noted that a 10 mm relative movement between jacking points could shift about 35% of the load. Lifting systems therefore need computer synchronisation, live load display at each point and automatic stops. Full closure of the deck was achieved in June 2007.
units.model: 節段 450 t 以 4 點提升，理想每點 112.5 t；若 10 mm 差動轉移 35%，即約 0.35×112.5 ≈ 39.4 t（約 386 kN），等效吊點勁度約 386/10 ≈ 38.6 kN/mm。容許荷重偏差 10% 時，差動須控制在約 10×(11.25/39.4) ≈ 2.9 mm 以內。節段重量為教學假設。~A 450 t segment lifted at 4 points ideally puts 112.5 t on each; if 10 mm of differential shifts 35%, that is about 0.35×112.5 ≈ 39.4 t (about 386 kN), an equivalent point stiffness of about 386/10 ≈ 38.6 kN/mm. To keep load deviation within 10%, the differential must stay within about 10×(11.25/39.4) ≈ 2.9 mm. The segment weight is a teaching assumption.
units.verify: 提升前做空載與試吊，校正各點位移感測器與壓力感測器；提升中即時記錄每點荷重與高程，設定偏差警戒與自動停機值；就位後量測節段高程、軸線與接縫間隙，焊接前確認與施工控制預測一致。~Before lifting, run unloaded and trial lifts to calibrate displacement and pressure sensors at each point; during lifting log each point’s load and level live with deviation alarms and automatic stop values; after placement survey segment level, alignment and joint gap and confirm agreement with construction-control predictions before welding.
units.failure: 同步失效時某吊點過載，可能使吊具、吊耳或節段局部挫屈，甚至發生墜落；節段就位時高程偏差未修正就焊接，誤差會沿懸臂累積，最後在合龍口形成難以處理的高差。~If synchronisation fails, one point overloads and rigging, lifting lugs or the segment can buckle locally or drop; welding a segment with an uncorrected level error lets the error accumulate along the cantilever into a hard-to-fix step at the closure gap.
units.misconception: 多點提升時只要總荷重在設備容量內，各吊點就一定安全。~In a multi-point lift, every point is safe as long as the total load is within equipment capacity.
units.practice: 重型提升計畫要列出每點容量、同步控制邏輯、偏差警戒與停機值、通訊失效的處置，以及颱風前的節段固定方式；第一次提升視為試驗，由提升工程師與監造共同簽認後才進入正式作業。~A heavy-lift plan should list point capacities, synchronisation logic, deviation alarms and stop values, communication-failure procedures and pre-typhoon segment securing; treat the first lift as a trial signed off by the lifting engineer and supervisor before routine work.

units.anchor: 全橋氣彈模型~Full aeroelastic model
units.title: 氣彈模型試驗與施工期抗風驗證~Aeroelastic model testing and construction-stage wind checks
units.mechanism: 千米級斜張橋最危險的風況往往出現在施工中：雙懸臂接近最大長度時，橋面只靠塔與斜索支撐，頻率低且沒有合龍後的整體勁度。全橋氣彈模型以縮尺重現質量、勁度與幾何，讓風洞中的模型與實橋有相同的折算風速，才能觀察抖振、渦振與顫振的整體行為。AECOM 公開資料指出其為承包商提供了橋梁氣動、風洞試驗與振動抑制等施工工程服務，說明施工單位也需要自己的風工程驗證，而不只依賴設計階段的成果。~For a 1 km class cable-stayed bridge the most dangerous wind case often occurs during construction: as the twin cantilevers approach maximum length, the deck is supported only by tower and stays, with low frequencies and none of the stiffness gained after closure. A full aeroelastic model reproduces mass, stiffness and geometry at scale so the model and bridge share the same reduced velocity, allowing buffeting, vortex vibration and flutter of the whole structure to be observed. AECOM’s public material states that it provided the contractor with construction engineering services including bridge aerodynamics, wind-tunnel testing and vibration mitigation, showing that the builder also needs its own wind verification rather than relying only on design-stage results.
units.model: Froude 相似的氣彈模型，長度比 λ = 1/150 時風速比 = √λ ≈ 0.0816，頻率比 = 1/√λ ≈ 12.25。實橋 50 m/s 對應風洞約 50×0.0816 ≈ 4.1 m/s；實橋頻率 0.2 Hz 的模態在模型中約 2.45 Hz。比例與風速為教學假設。~For a Froude-scaled aeroelastic model with length ratio λ = 1/150, the velocity ratio is √λ ≈ 0.0816 and the frequency ratio 1/√λ ≈ 12.25. A full-scale 50 m/s corresponds to about 50×0.0816 ≈ 4.1 m/s in the tunnel, and a 0.2 Hz bridge mode appears at about 2.45 Hz in the model. Scale and speed are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 先以敲擊或激振確認模型各主要模態頻率與阻尼符合目標（例如頻率誤差在約 5% 內），再於均勻流與紊流場中掃描風速，記錄懸臂端位移與加速度，換算成實橋值並與施工期允許位移、構件強度比較。~First confirm by tapping or shaker tests that the model’s main modal frequencies and damping meet their targets (for example frequencies within about 5%), then sweep wind speed in smooth and turbulent flow, recording cantilever-tip displacement and acceleration, converting to full scale and comparing with allowable construction displacements and member capacities.
units.failure: 若模型阻尼過高或勁度不符，試驗會低估施工期振幅，現場在中等風速下出現模型未預測的大幅擺動；未把吊機、臨時設備的質量與迎風面積納入模型，也會使結果失真。~Excess damping or wrong stiffness in the model underestimates construction-stage amplitudes, so the site sees large sway at moderate wind that the model missed; leaving out crane and temporary-equipment mass and area also distorts the results.
units.misconception: 風洞模型只要外形相似，不需要考慮質量與勁度的縮尺。~A wind-tunnel model only needs the right shape; mass and stiffness scaling do not matter.
units.practice: 施工期風洞試驗應模擬最不利的懸臂長度與吊機位置，試驗報告要給出各施工階段的作業風速上限與臨時抗風索或阻尼器的需求，並納入施工手冊。~Construction-stage wind tests should model the worst cantilever length and crane positions, and the report should give working wind limits for each stage and any need for temporary wind cables or dampers, incorporated into the construction manual.

units.title: 長江口河床沖刷監測與防護~Scour monitoring and protection in the Yangtze estuary
units.mechanism: 主塔承台平面約 114 m × 48 m，是長江口中的巨大障礙物，水流在其上游側形成下沉流與馬蹄形渦流，把承台周圍的砂土帶走。潮汐每天兩次反向，加上汛期大流量，沖刷坑會隨季節加深或回淤。摩擦樁的承載仰賴上部土層的圍束，沖刷深度增加就等於縮短有效樁長並增加樁的自由長度，降低側向勁度。大型深水基礎因此常在施工前後鋪設拋石或袋裝砂的護底層，並在營運期定期測深，確認防護層沒有被掏空。~The main-tower caps, about 114 m × 48 m in plan, are huge obstacles in the estuary; flow forms a down-flow and horseshoe vortex on their upstream side and carries away sand around the cap. Tides reverse twice a day and flood seasons bring large discharges, so the scour hole deepens or refills seasonally. Friction piles rely on confinement by the upper soil, so deeper scour shortens effective pile length and increases free length, reducing lateral stiffness. Large deep-water foundations therefore commonly receive riprap or sand-bag aprons before and after construction, with periodic soundings in service to confirm the apron has not been undermined.
units.model: 回聲測深 d = v·t/2。聲速 v = 1,500 m/s、往返時間 t = 0.040 s，d = 1,500×0.040/2 = 30 m；若施工前同點水深 22 m，則沖刷約 30 − 22 = 8 m，並以單元 3 的側阻估算每減少 1 m 有效埋深約損失 π×2.8×1×60 ≈ 528 kN 側阻。數值為教學假設。~Echo sounding d = v·t/2. With sound speed v = 1,500 m/s and a round trip t = 0.040 s, d = 1,500×0.040/2 = 30 m; if the pre-construction depth at that point was 22 m, scour is about 30 − 22 = 8 m, and with the unit 3 friction each metre of lost embedment removes about π×2.8×1×60 ≈ 528 kN of shaft resistance. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以多音束測深在汛期前後與颱風後掃描承台周圍，建立數值地形並與基準比較沖刷坑深度與範圍；聲速依水溫鹽度校正，潮位以同步潮位站修正；護底層以側掃聲納或潛水檢查完整性。~Survey around the caps with multibeam sounding before and after flood seasons and after typhoons, build digital terrain and compare scour-hole depth and extent with the baseline; correct sound speed for temperature and salinity and water level from a synchronised tide gauge; check apron integrity by side-scan sonar or divers.
units.failure: 護底層邊緣被掏空後拋石滑落，沖刷坑會快速擴大到承台下方；若只在平水期測深，可能錯過汛期最深的沖刷而在回淤後誤判為安全。~Once the apron edge is undermined and stones slide, the scour hole can grow rapidly under the cap; sounding only in low-flow periods can miss the deepest flood-season scour and wrongly conclude safety after refilling.
units.misconception: 沖刷坑在洪水後會自然回淤，所以不會影響基樁承載。~Scour holes refill naturally after floods, so they never affect pile capacity.
units.practice: 維護計畫要規定定期與事件後的測深頻率、沖刷警戒深度與補拋石的啟動條件；測深資料以相同座標系統與基準面保存，便於多年比較。~The maintenance plan should set routine and post-event sounding frequencies, a scour alert depth and the trigger for replenishing riprap; store soundings in one coordinate system and datum for multi-year comparison.

units.title: 300 m 混凝土塔的壓縮、徐變與長期線形~Shortening, creep and long-term geometry of 300 m concrete towers
units.mechanism: 混凝土塔在自重、斜索垂直分力與後期鋪面荷載下會彈性壓縮，之後還有收縮與徐變持續縮短。300 m 高的塔累積縮短量可達十公分量級，直接使錨點下降、斜索幾何改變，進而影響橋面線形與索力。公開論文把塔形控制列為蘇通大橋塔施工的重點之一。施工時要以預抬量把每個錨點設在略高的位置，讓長期縮短後回到設計高程；營運期則需追蹤塔頂高程與索力的長期趨勢，分辨徐變造成的正常變化與異常沉陷。~A concrete tower shortens elastically under self-weight, the vertical components of stay forces and later surfacing loads, and then keeps shortening by shrinkage and creep. In a 300 m tower the accumulated shortening can reach the order of ten centimetres, lowering anchor points, changing stay geometry and thus the deck profile and stay forces. Published papers list tower shape control as a key issue in building the Sutong towers. During construction anchor points are set higher by a pre-elevation so they return to design level after long-term shortening; in service, long-term trends in tower-top level and stay forces must be tracked to separate normal creep from abnormal settlement.
units.model: 應力由頂部 0 線性增加到底部 σ = 10 MPa 時，彈性縮短 δ = σ·H/(2E)。取 H = 300 m、E = 36 GPa：δ = 10×300,000/(2×36,000) ≈ 41.7 mm；徐變係數 φ = 1.5 時總縮短約 41.7×2.5 ≈ 104 mm。應力與材料參數為教學假設。~With stress rising linearly from zero at the top to σ = 10 MPa at the base, elastic shortening is δ = σ·H/(2E). With H = 300 m and E = 36 GPa, δ = 10×300,000/(2×36,000) ≈ 41.7 mm; with a creep coefficient φ = 1.5 the total is about 41.7×2.5 ≈ 104 mm. Stress and material values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 在塔身埋設振弦式應變計與溫度計，分離彈性、溫度、收縮與徐變應變；以精密水準與 GNSS 定期量測塔頂與錨點高程，與時間相依分析的預測曲線比較，偏差超過門檻時檢討索力調整需求。~Embed vibrating-wire strain gauges and thermometers in the tower to separate elastic, thermal, shrinkage and creep strains; survey tower-top and anchor levels periodically by precise levelling and GNSS and compare with time-dependent analysis predictions, reviewing the need for stay adjustment when deviations exceed thresholds.
units.failure: 若預抬量只算彈性縮短而忽略徐變，數年後錨點持續下沉，主跨跨中下撓、索力重分配，鋪面與伸縮縫出現異常；若量測不分離溫度效應，又可能把季節變化誤判為徐變。~Pre-elevation based on elastic shortening only lets anchors keep sinking for years, sagging the main span, redistributing stay forces and distressing surfacing and joints; measurements that do not separate temperature may also mistake seasonal change for creep.
units.misconception: 混凝土塔完工後高度就固定不變，不需要預留壓縮量。~A concrete tower’s height is fixed once complete, so no allowance for shortening is needed.
units.practice: 施工控制文件要列出每個錨點的預抬量組成（彈性、收縮、徐變、基礎沉陷），並在交接時提供時間相依分析的預測曲線，讓維護單位能把實測值放在同一張圖上比較。~Construction-control documents should break down each anchor’s pre-elevation into elastic, shrinkage, creep and foundation settlement parts, and handover should provide the time-dependent prediction curves so the maintainer can plot measurements against them.

units.anchor: 577 m 最長索~The 577 m longest stay
units.title: 超長斜索的多模態振動與阻尼維護~Multi-mode vibration and damper upkeep for very long stays
units.mechanism: 蘇通大橋最長斜索約 577 m，第一頻率極低，風雨、渦流與橋面運動可能激發其第 5 階甚至第 10 階以上的模態。外置阻尼器只能裝在靠近橋面錨點的位置，而每個模態的最佳阻尼係數不同：對低階模態最佳的係數，對高階模態可能太硬或太軟。因此長索的減振設計要先找出可能被激發的頻率範圍，再選擇在該範圍內都能提供足夠附加阻尼的阻尼器參數，並在營運期定期檢查阻尼器是否漏油、卡滯或支架鬆動。~The longest Sutong stay is about 577 m, with a very low first frequency, so rain, wind, vortices and deck motion can excite its fifth or even tenth mode and above. External dampers can only be installed near the deck anchorage, and the optimum damping coefficient differs for each mode: a value optimal for low modes can be too stiff or too soft for higher ones. Vibration control for long stays therefore starts by identifying the frequency range likely to be excited, then chooses damper parameters that give enough added damping across that range, with periodic in-service checks for leaks, seizure or loose brackets.
units.model: f₁ = (1/2L)·√(T/m)，取 L = 577 m、T = 8,000 kN、m = 110 kg/m：√(8×10⁶/110) ≈ 269.7 m/s，f₁ ≈ 269.7/1,154 ≈ 0.234 Hz。風雨振常見的 1 至 3 Hz 對應 n ≈ 1/0.234 至 3/0.234，即約第 5 至第 12 階；最佳阻尼係數與 1/n 成正比，第 12 階只需第 1 階的約 1/12。數值為教學假設。~f₁ = (1/2L)·√(T/m); with L = 577 m, T = 8,000 kN and m = 110 kg/m, √(8×10⁶/110) ≈ 269.7 m/s and f₁ ≈ 269.7/1,154 ≈ 0.234 Hz. The 1 to 3 Hz band typical of rain–wind vibration corresponds to n ≈ 1/0.234 to 3/0.234, roughly modes 5 to 12; since the optimum damping coefficient scales with 1/n, mode 12 needs only about 1/12 of the mode-1 value. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以加速度計記錄索在風雨事件中的頻譜，確認實際被激發的模態；裝設阻尼器後做自由衰減或強迫振動試驗，逐階量測附加阻尼比，確認目標範圍內各階都達到設計值，並每年抽查阻尼器行程與漏油狀況。~Record cable spectra during wind–rain events with accelerometers to confirm which modes are excited; after damper installation run free-decay or forced tests to measure added damping mode by mode, confirming the design value across the target range, and spot-check damper stroke and leakage yearly.
units.failure: 阻尼器只針對第一階調整，結果在 1 至 3 Hz 的高階模態幾乎沒有效果，風雨天長索仍大幅振動；長期振動使錨口彎曲應力與 HDPE 套管磨損增加，造成防護失效與疲勞風險。~Tuning dampers to mode 1 only leaves them nearly ineffective for the higher modes at 1 to 3 Hz, so long stays still vibrate heavily in wind and rain; sustained vibration increases bending stress at the anchor exit and wear of the HDPE duct, compromising protection and adding fatigue risk.
units.misconception: 超長斜索只會以第一階模態振動，只要針對第一階設計阻尼器即可。~Very long stays vibrate only in the first mode, so dampers need only target mode 1.
units.practice: 長索阻尼器的規格書應寫明目標模態範圍、各階最低附加阻尼與溫度範圍內的性能變化；監測系統保留幾根代表性長索的長期加速度紀錄，作為檢討是否需要加裝交叉索或更換阻尼器的依據。~Long-stay damper specifications should state the target mode range, minimum added damping per mode and performance change over temperature; keep long-term acceleration records on a few representative long stays as the basis for deciding on cross-ties or damper replacement.

example: 設計練習：估算塔頂在風荷載下的附加彎矩。取塔上段迎風寬 b = 10 m，以單元 2 的指數律求 z = 300 m 時 U ≈ 57.2 m/s，q = ½ρU² = 0.5×1.225×57.2² ≈ 2,004 Pa；取阻力係數 C_D = 1.3，每公尺風力 w = 2,004×1.3×10 ≈ 26.1 kN/m。若塔上 100 m 平均承受此風力、合力作用於塔頂以下 50 m，對 200 m 高程處的彎矩 M = 26.1×100×50 ≈ 130,300 kN·m。若改用橋面高度 70 m 的風速 48.0 m/s，q ≈ 1,411 Pa，w ≈ 18.3 kN/m，M ≈ 91,700 kN·m，低估約 30%（1 − 91,700/130,300 ≈ 0.30）。若塔寬改為 8 m，兩者都乘以 0.8。數值為教學假設，不代表蘇通大橋的設計。~Design exercise: estimate the extra moment from wind on the upper tower. Take an upper-tower width b = 10 m; from the unit 2 power law U ≈ 57.2 m/s at z = 300 m, so q = ½ρU² = 0.5×1.225×57.2² ≈ 2,004 Pa; with C_D = 1.3 the force per metre is w = 2,004×1.3×10 ≈ 26.1 kN/m. If the top 100 m of tower carries this on average with the resultant 50 m below the top, the moment at the 200 m level is M = 26.1×100×50 ≈ 130,300 kN·m. Using the deck-level speed of 48.0 m/s at 70 m instead gives q ≈ 1,411 Pa, w ≈ 18.3 kN/m and M ≈ 91,700 kN·m, an underestimate of about 30% (1 − 91,700/130,300 ≈ 0.30). If the tower width becomes 8 m, both scale by 0.8. Values are teaching assumptions, not the Sutong design.
history: 蘇通大橋連接江蘇蘇州與南通，初步設計由中交公路規劃設計院、江蘇省交通規劃設計院與同濟大學聯合體承擔，2003 年 6 月開工，主橋由中國交通建設集團第二航務工程局總承包，英國 Dorman Long Technology 負責重型提升，AECOM 為承包商提供架設分析、線形控制與風工程服務。主梁於 2007 年 6 月合龍，2008 年 5 月試通車、6 月 30 日正式通車，以 1,088 m 主跨刷新斜張橋紀錄，並以 300.4 m 的塔與約 577 m 的斜索創下當時紀錄；2010 年獲美國土木工程師學會傑出土木工程成就獎。本課只重建公開工程原理，不代表任何設計文件。~Sutong Bridge links Suzhou and Nantong in Jiangsu. Preliminary design was by a consortium of the CCCC Highway Planning and Design Institute, Jiangsu Provincial Communications Planning and Design Institute and Tongji University; construction began in June 2003 with CCCC Second Navigational Engineering Bureau as general contractor, Dorman Long Technology of the UK handling heavy lifts and AECOM providing erection analysis, geometry control and wind engineering to the contractor. The deck closed in June 2007, trial traffic began in May 2008 and the bridge officially opened on 30 June 2008, setting a cable-stayed span record of 1,088 m with record 300.4 m towers and stays of about 577 m; in 2010 it received ASCE’s Outstanding Civil Engineering Achievement award. This course reconstructs public engineering principles only and represents no design document.
facts: 倒 Y 形混凝土主塔高 300.4 m~The inverted-Y concrete towers are 300.4 m tall
最長斜拉索約 577 m~The longest stay is about 577 m
每座主塔由 131 根鑽孔灌注樁支承，直徑達 2.8 m、長約 120 m~Each main tower stands on 131 bored piles up to 2.8 m in diameter and about 120 m long
主塔群樁平面約 114 m × 48 m~Each main-tower pile group is about 114 m × 48 m in plan
通航淨空寬 891 m、高 62 m~Navigation clearance is 891 m wide and 62 m high
鋼箱梁含風嘴寬約 41 m~The steel box deck is about 41 m wide including fairings
樁垂直度設計容許 1/200，實際達約 1/400~Pile verticality tolerance was 1/200, with about 1/400 achieved
跨江大橋全長約 8,206 m，整體路線約 32.4 km~The river crossing is about 8,206 m long within a route of about 32.4 km

timeline.event: 6 月 27 日主體工程開工，先建深水施工平台~Main construction starts on 27 June, beginning with deep-water work platforms
